name: Hyrican Informationssysteme Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Hyrican Informationssysteme Aktiengesellschaft offers IT systems and solutions in Germany and internationally. The company provides PCs, notebooks, servers, workstations, and peripherals. It also offers gaming systems; and supplies hardware products. In addition, the company provides IT solutions, including mobility technologies, cloud computing, and data center solutions; and client management, server and storage, IT security, networking, software, and communication solutions, as well as managed, professional, and training services. Further, it offers LED lighting solutions, such as LED hall downlight, street light, tubes, ceiling and wall panels, flood and tunnel lights, downlights and spots, and light strip systems; and business to business solutions for public sector, education sector, industries, and companies.
